comment: The owners of the paths are selected by scripts/features/owners.mts from contracts/check-inputs.json and contracts/features.json: the checks that need the database servers run with a bench and a decimal database of their own, which only that script creates. One rule hands every changed path to it.

ciExempt.reason: it runs the owners of the changed paths, each a target of CHECK_TARGETS; the CI workflow runs make orm-check, which runs every target of CHECK_TARGETS, so a step of the selection would run them twice
